limitations: Only the unit tube-simplex Minkowski realization of the star graph associahedron with its intrinsic Euclidean metric; no assertions for alternative affine realizations, nonuniform tube weights, or general graph associahedra. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_integrity: An exact all-dimensional analytical argument proves the cut reduction and the integer threshold; finite exact-rational checks are corroborative, not proof of an infinite claim.
title: A sharp fourteen-leaf transition in the Euclidean width of the simplex-sum stellohedron
